title: Making Open Models 10x faster and better for Modern Application Innovation: Dmytro (Dima) Dzhulgakov
talk_summary: A Fireworks AI founder pitches their serving stack for open models, arguing that smaller fine-tuned/domain-specialized models plus cross-stack serving optimization beat big frontier models on latency and cost for narrow use cases. The only concrete mechanisms are LoRA multi-tenancy on shared GPUs, latency-constrained throughput tuning, and function-calling-specialized models with JSON grammar mode.

takeaways.technique: Latency-constrained cost minimization (pick model/serving config per latency SLO)
takeaways.what_they_do: Frame serving as 'minimize cost under a particular latency constraint' and tune batching/serving settings per use case rather than using one config for all traffic.
takeaways.evidence_quote: think about Max like minimizing cost under a particular latency constraint
takeaways.numbers: claims up to 10x faster for fine-tuned Llama 3 on function calling vs big model; 'multiple times higher throughput' from tuning

takeaways.technique: LoRA multi-tenancy / many adapters per GPU
takeaways.what_they_do: Serve thousands of LoRA fine-tunes on shared GPUs with per-token serverless pricing, avoiding fixed cost per model variant.
takeaways.evidence_quote: deploy multiple plur models on the same GPU uh actually thousands of them
takeaways.numbers: thousands of model variants on same GPU, no fixed cost

takeaways.technique: Function-calling-specialized small model + JSON grammar/structured generation
takeaways.what_they_do: Use a model trained specifically for function calling with JSON grammar-constrained output to reliably translate user intent into multi-step tool calls.
takeaways.evidence_quote: structure generation uh with like with Json model grammar mode

takeaways.what_they_do: Demo agent detects when the conversation moves to a new topic and deliberately discards stale history rather than carrying it forward.
